name: Lentil & Mushroom Sloppy Joes with Avocado-Spinach Salad

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups brown lentils
1065 ml chicken or vegetable broth
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
3 green bell peppers
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince onions and garlic; transfer both to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop mushrooms. Trim, seed, and roughly chop peppers. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add vegetables, sugar, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp cumin
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp chili powder

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and salt in the bowl used for the veggies. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp brown sugar
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Add tomato sauce to the skillet, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocados. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out into the bowl with the dressing. Add spinach and toss to combine the salad.
When the lentils are tender, drain, and add to the skillet with the vegetables; stir to combine the sloppy joe mix.
To serve, place the bottom half of a bun on each plate. Top with sloppy joe mix and close with top half of the bun. Divide salad between plates and enjoy!
